title: Build rapport before the stream
summary: Pre-stream nerves are real. Mirror her energy and lift it.
steps: Join on time and start with a real conversation, not the checklist.
Mirror her energy, then lift it. Hype her up and keep her excited to stream.
Walk through the plan, the goals and what success looks like tonight.
Ask how she feels about each scene and adjust before going live.
tips: Being present is not the same as performing. Be fast, accurate and engaged.
Small errors (wrong numbers, wrong prices) cost her trust. Double-check before you tell her.

title: Play to her strengths
summary: No generic playbook. Find what she does best and build the stream around it.
steps: Name her top 2–3 strengths (for example humour, dancing, storytelling).
Choose scenes and goals that let those strengths show.
After each stream, note what landed and do more of it next time.

title: Check-ins and preferences
summary: Know her boundaries and preferences before going live, and respect them every time.
steps: Confirm boundaries, persona details and privacy settings on the pre-stream call.
Agree on a quick private signal for breaks or changes during the stream.
Check in during slow moments: energy, comfort, anything she wants to change.
After the stream, ask for her feedback first, then share 1–2 wins and one improvement.
tips: Treat her as the client. Her experience matters as much as the results.
Keep internal coaching out of the model recap.
